title: Useful useless items
body:
**Vanilla plugin, adds more utility for forgotten items, as well as a couple of balanced crafts for vanilla items.**

## config:
**You can customize the configuration as you wish by turning on and off any items. Your server, your rules!**

To turn off any innovation, write false in front of it, turn off the recipe for this item (the logic of this item is also turned off, but if the players made it before it was turned off, it will not work)
